about: The context guard at the end of a turn: the executor's hook (internal/hook) runs these cases. A case plays its stops in order against one state directory and one executor state ($XDG_STATE_HOME/aacpanel). guards is guards.tsv there, null for no file; env is laid over an environment without CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR. The snapshot holds one session, row with the case's and the stop's row laid over it, and sessionsAt that many seconds from clock where the case names it; nostate is no snapshot at all. The look at the work in the background runs on a clock of its own from clock, a step a sleep; fresh is laid over the row of the snapshot the collector writes at its first sleep. restarting are markers of a restart under way and sent marks of an ask sent, by name, aged that many seconds of the wall clock; a stop's restarting replaces the case's. A stop's payload is laid over a Stop of the session in the project, or input is the raw text. says is null for nothing, the block's reason whole as text or by words in has. marks names the files of the marks directory after the stop, null for none; restartingLeft the markers left.

cases.what: past the cap the session is told to wrap up and restart itself, silently

says.text: The context of this session is at 84% of the model window and has reached the 80% this project set as its context cap, where the project restarts its sessions. Take no new work. Put the state of the work on disk the way this project keeps it: its finalize skill if it has one, otherwise a handoff note for the next session and a commit of what is done. Then restart this session with session_restart, the tool of the panel's server (mcp__aacpanel__session_restart), without continue: the panel starts a fresh session in this place with the project's parameters. Do not go on with this conversation. The restart is automatic: do it silently, and do not tell the person about the context, the cap or the restart, nor that the next session will continue.
